subject: Post-demo: confirmation of decision criteria, procurement intake, and next gates
messages:
From: Amelia Grant <amelia.grant@finovatehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@finovatehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for the demo — procurement & decision criteria

Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — team found the latency and batching approach compelling. Two follow-ups on our side as we align internally:

1) Decision criteria: our procurement and engineering leads will score vendors primarily on (a) SLA-backed latency at 95th percentile, (b) TCO at target QPS, (c) private-deployment support for PHI workloads, and (d) integration effort with our ML infra. Can you confirm the best Redwood SKU/offerings you recommend for a pilot that exercises these dimensions?

2) Procurement intake: we need a completed supplier intake form + SOC2/high-level security summary to start legal/procurement review. Can you send a short attachable packet and a single point of contact for procurement?

3) Timeline ask: our committee wants an internal procurement readiness check by Oct 29 and a formal vendor short-list the week after. Is Redwood comfortable with a PO decision window in early Nov if the pilot meets the bar?

Appreciate a clear list of next steps so I can circulate to our procurement and security SMEs.

—Amelia
Amelia Grant
Director, Vendor Enablement | Finovate Health
amelia.grant@finovatehealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0143

(Attachment requested: supplier_intake_form.pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Grant <amelia.grant@finovatehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2027 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — procurement & decision criteria

Hi Amelia — great to meet you and the Finovate crew today. Short recap and concrete next steps below.

Quick answers to your bullets:
- Recommended pilot configuration: Redwood Dedicated pilot (2x A100 equiv) with private VPC control plane; this will let you test 95th p95 latency at sustained QPS and validate private deployment for PHI flows. I will include a rough cost estimate in the packet.
- Security packet: attaching our SOC2 summary + an intake form we ask customers to fill.
- Timeline: we can support a procurement readiness checkpoint by Oct 29 and are prepared to accelerate contract review if the pilot results look good — early Nov PO timeline is reasonable.

Next steps (owners / ETA):
1) I attach: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf, supplier_intake_form.pdf, proposed-onboarding-scope.xlsx — please share supplier_intake_form to your procurement SME and return by Oct 25. (Owner: Finovate)
2) I'll loop in our Contract Ops and send a draft Master Services Addendum with standard SLAs by Oct 27. (Owner: Marcus / Contract Ops)
3) Neha (cc) will coordinate a security 30-min call next week to walk the SOC2 controls and onboarding encryption/KMS options. Please suggest 2 windows. (Owner: Neha / Amelia)
4) Aditya (cc) will prepare a pilot runbook + perf targets so your engineers know the validation steps. (Owner: Aditya)

If that works I'll send a single zip with the packet and a single contact for procurement (myself + ContractsOps).

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0210

Attachments: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf; supplier_intake_form.pdf; proposed-onboarding-scope.xlsx

Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — procurement & decision criteria

Amelia — jumping in from Contracts/Finance to outline procurement intake expectations and a few templates to speed review.

Attached: supplier_intake_form.pdf (fillable), proposed-onboarding-scope.xlsx (sticker price and optional professional services), and a short procurement checklist. High level:
- Standard payment terms: Net 30 by default; we can provide Net 45/60 on approved credit with a PSC.
- Pilot billing model: monthly usage + reserved capacity overlay; the onboarding scope sheet lists an estimated pilot spend band.
- SLAs: we'll include p95 latency SLOs and an escalation path in the MSAD.

Please confirm the procurement contact (name + email) we should expect the returned intake form from. If Amelias's team needs a PO template or invoice address, send that and we'll populate.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Contract Operations | Redwood Inference

Marcus / Lauren — thanks for the quick turnaround and the packet. A couple quick signals from procurement:

- We'll return the supplier intake form by Monday Oct 25 (owner: procurement intake team).
- Our security lead asked for a short 30-minute sync; available windows: Mon 10/25 11:00-11:30 PT or Tue 10/26 14:00-14:30 PT.
- For PO routing: please send invoice address and whether Redwood accepts ACH or requires wire details.
- Decision signal: if pilot meets p95 latency targets and the integration work matches the runbook, we will look to include Redwood in our vendor short-list and target a PO in the first two weeks of Nov.

Procurement contact: Eun-Ji Park <eunji.park@finovatehealth.com> — she'll own the returned intake packet and any KYC.

Best,
